design_class: Exploratory response to the disclosed partial first perturbation attempt
method: Keep all already certified three-dimensional leaves from the uniform perturbation attempt; directly enclose the original raw polynomials over the full rho interval on each unresolved continuous alpha-eta leaf.
failure_rule: Any unresolved leaf prevents a full-domain claim; the earlier narrow fallback stays valid independently.
success_rule: Every original leaf must be covered exactly once by a finite closed subtree; all retained or direct B and negative-D lower bounds must be strictly positive over the full continuous rho interval.
scope: Padé structural certification, not a new price experiment at a changed correlation.
